defects: Planned shared derivation has no coherent API or integration point. `auditStagedTree(root)` receives only root, while plan also says it "takes the `ManifestRead`". `ManifestRead` has bytes/mode or link target only, no path list; stage callback receives separate `(rel, read)` values. Implementer can only re-enumerate tree or invent unstated buffering/wiring, breaking claimed one-truth design.

Plan validates/audits files before staged execution but lacks required source-mutation control proving checked bytes are used bytes. Ignored-file and exec-bit controls prove inventory inclusion, not TOCTOU safety between audit and staging/use.
No planned assertion covers required 50 MB warning. Feature can omit logging, use wrong threshold, or log wrong path and listed control still passes.
